Read what comes back: The page's GET /work/api/search, run by the engine for the page's account (workshop-routes): the request's { path, method, query } in, { status, body } out, where body is the one search's answer (searchEverything) for query q, with places, sources and matches as comma lists and limit (1..200) as old src/search.mjs searchOptions read them.
